依官方入門建立隔離的最小專案並安裝指定版本。
執行範例與現有測試，檢查成功結果及錯誤輸出。
每次只變動一個需求，保留設定、鎖定版本與操作紀錄。
learningStepsEn: Identify whether this is a library, developer tool or complete application.
Create an isolated minimal project using the documented version requirements.
Run official examples and tests; inspect successful results and errors.
Change one requirement at a time and retain configuration and version records.
